newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: SIMEX Oct Brent fell, to test $22.00 on IPE.
newsitem.headline: SIMEX Oct Brent fell, to test $22.00 on IPE.

text.p: SIMEX Brent futures slipped from from its midday high and is expected to drift lower on further downward correction, brokers said on Wednesday.

October was last traded at $22.12 a barrel, down nine cents from its last close on the London's IPE and 38 cents below the day's high of $22.50 after the U.S. launched its second missile attack on Iraq earlier in the day.
A total of 554 lots were traded for October, 76 lots for November and 75 lots for December.
Brokers said the the prompt October contract would test a support of $22.
Trading on the ACCESS after-hours system fell to $23.36, four cents under its last NYMEX close, from a high of $23.65.
